may_observe: local canonical scope/identity/device/conversation state; plaintext needed for local authoring/render/decryption; local route/network metadata; authorization results
must_not_observe: other-tenant state; infrastructure credentials; exportable private keys outside the key-provider boundary; recovery secrets outside an explicit recovery operation
retention: local policy; EPHEMERAL state is non-durable unless explicitly promoted by contract
export_rule: no implicit central upload; only policy-authorized protocol or purpose-specific diagnostic export

may_observe: authorized public-contract fields for the authenticated caller scope; explicit canonical errors; opaque IDs returned by the API
must_not_observe: raw database state; other-tenant data; private keys; recovery/authentication secrets; internal replay/routing state; fields lacking permission
retention: application policy subject to UCR contract/data classification
export_rule: public contract only; no direct database or hidden export path

may_observe: public request/response data; caller-supplied authentication material only transiently when an auth scheme is defined
must_not_observe: raw database state; private keys not supplied for an explicit operation; recovery secrets; hidden authorization state; unrelated tenant data
retention: transient by default; SDK caches require an explicit contract and classification
export_rule: same public contract as External App; SDK cannot add a hidden telemetry or data-export path

may_observe: canonical scoped runtime state required for the operation; policy/permission decisions; plaintext before transport encryption or after authorized local decryption; routing candidates
must_not_observe: exportable private signing/agreement key bytes; recovery secrets outside recovery operation; product-specific business graph; unrelated tenant state
retention: capability-specific durable/ephemeral policy; persistence is not telemetry
export_rule: only through explicit storage, transport, public-contract, audit, or purpose-specific diagnostic boundaries

may_observe: transport peer/network addresses; relay route/session handle; encrypted payload length and timing; minimal routing/delivery state
must_not_observe: plaintext message or attachment content; private/recovery/authentication keys; provider credentials; full social graph or group roster; unrelated canonical state
retention: short-lived routing/abuse window defined by deployment; no content archive
export_rule: only relay-required routing/abuse evidence; no plaintext or general canonical-state export

may_observe: configured provider/integration context; target provider identifiers; delivery metadata; content/attachments only when the explicit bridge action and policy require provider-visible content
must_not_observe: unrelated tenants/conversations; private/recovery keys; hidden permission grants; full social graph; provider context unrelated to the configured action
retention: minimum provider reconciliation window; provider-visible content follows explicit bridge/provider retention policy
export_rule: only configured provider action and canonical result/evidence; no general UCR database export

may_observe: media session/stream routing identifiers; network transport tuples; encrypted media packet size/timing; negotiated media-routing context
must_not_observe: message plaintext; private/recovery/authentication keys; unrelated conversation history; media plaintext unless an explicitly reviewed media architecture requires it
retention: ephemeral media-routing window plus explicit abuse/audit policy
export_rule: media routing/health evidence only; no automatic plaintext recording or canonical-history export

may_observe: owner-assigned tenant/scope durable and sync state; network/routing metadata; content only as explicitly selected by the owner deployment
must_not_observe: other-tenant state; authority inferred from possession; exportable private keys outside key provider; undisclosed central telemetry
retention: owner-defined local retention constrained by canonical classification and recovery policy
export_rule: owner-configured sync/backup/diagnostic paths only; no mandatory cloud export

may_observe: explicitly authorized organization tenant/namespace state; sync/routing metadata; audit/security metadata; content only according to organization policy and granted authority
must_not_observe: other tenants; authority inferred from node ownership; recovery history not explicitly organization-managed; exportable private keys outside key provider
retention: organization retention policy with tenant isolation and audit controls
export_rule: authorized organization sync/audit/backup paths only; no cross-tenant or silent historical-content export

may_observe: hosting/network/resource metadata and only the application metadata permitted to each explicitly deployed child role
must_not_observe: extra application visibility merely because infrastructure is cloud-hosted; private/recovery keys unless a separately declared key-provider role requires them; mandatory global identity/social graph
retention: per deployed child role; cloud hosting creates no additional retention entitlement
export_rule: each hosted child component follows its own contract; native/local Identity and durable state require no cloud account or central export

may_observe: component health; bounded counters; timings; sizes; canonical error categories; explicitly approved pseudonymous correlation metadata
must_not_observe: plaintext messages; decrypted attachments; recovery secrets; authentication secrets; KEY_MATERIAL; raw endpoint addresses/provider IDs except authorized purpose-specific diagnostics
retention: time-bounded deployment policy; EPHEMERAL by default unless explicitly classified AUDIT
export_rule: optional local/organization/managed sink; protocol operation never depends on central telemetry upload
